evidence.observation: Reboiler heater at ~431-445 °C, far above T703 (~80-90 °C), rising steadily and flattening — very large heater-to-liquid gap suggests poor heat transfer / possible dry or fouled heater surface
Reboiler liquid temperature climbing slowly (80.7 → 90.2 °C) over 20 min, still heating up
Top-section temperatures flat at ~63-64 °C, no vapour front has reached the top yet
Distillate and reflux flows low and noisy (0.12-0.24 / 0.21-0.43), no established reflux
Column pressure drop stays ~0.4-0.7 mbar, consistent with minimal vapour traffic

args.missing_evidence: Heater power/setpoint for H701 and reboiler level to confirm whether the 445 °C heater temperature is a control artifact, a dry heater, or a T701 calibration/drift issue; also a top-composition or product sample once the column reaches steady state.
